beats.narration_en: What stops a giant ship from knocking down a bridge?
A pier can't take that hit, so engineers put guards around it.
These round islands are called dolphins.
Each is a steel ring packed with up to six thousand seven hundred tons of crushed rock.
When a ship hits, the ring bends and the rock packs tighter.
The ship's bow crumples too, soaking up its energy.
So the ship stops before it ever touches the pier.
Each one can take nearly thirty million pounds of force.
Florida built them after a ship knocked down its Sunshine Skyway bridge in nineteen eighty.
